name: be 动词与主谓一致
descs: A rabbit is a small animal.
I am hungry. 与 He is climbing.
I like… 和 Friends like… 都用原形
I will hop over、you will fly over
It is a river. 说明是什么

name: 定冠词 the 与零冠词
descs: is for 后的可数名词用单数，不加冠词

name: 专有名词与书写规范
descs: good 用句号，bad 用感叹号
句首与单词首字母大写
句首大写，单词首字母与所给字母一致
句首大写，单词首字母跟所给字母对应
句首字母、单词首字母大写，句末用句号
句首字母与单词首字母大写
句首字母与所代表单词的首字母都用大写

name: 一般现在时
descs: Animals can help people do their work.
Do you want to make one?
exs: A big tanker goes to the farm.
A rabbit goes in and out.
Do you like to play...? / Do you like playing...?

name: 名词复数
descs: a drum 是单数，drums 是复数
a lot of shells、a lot of coins
a story 是单数，复数加 s 变 stories
bears 加 -s，表示一类或一家
exs: We are slow, said the hippos.
We are slow, said the snails.

name: 不可数名词
descs: Some fishermen take too much fish.
food、rain 不可数，前面不加 a
fruit 表示水果总称，不加 -s
music 不加 -s，不用 a 修饰
exs: He likes to watch games, too.

name: 感叹句
descs: Look how fast I can go.
SPUFF、HUFF 模仿声音，可单独成句
exs: F is for feathers and f is for fly!

name: 不定冠词 a / an
descs: a farm 泛指一个农场

name: 祈使句与日常用语
descs: Let's + 动词原形，表示建议
Look at + 名词，提醒别人看
动词原形开头，提醒别人注意

name: 现在进行时
descs: Looking at Bugs 表示正在看
be + 动词 ing，表正在发生
exs: I am going up the mountain.

name: 形容词的用法
descs: big 放在 be 动词后说明主语
exs: Baby rabbits keep safe and warm.
It is red with black spots.
Mouse is the strongest animal of all.

name: 并列与转折（and / or / but）
descs: Birds have beaks, but no teeth.
But the zookeeper did not wake up.
It can run and hide and keep very still.
It can't fly, but it runs fast.
Its back legs are big, but its tail is short.
They ran and ran to get to their friends.
You will walk and jump in the water.
exs: B is for butterfly and b is for bee.
C is for cake and c is for candles.
F is for feathers and f is for fly!
F is for fox and x is in fox.
H is for horse and h is for hen.
T is for tiger and t is for turtle.
This gate can open and close.
This is big. But this is little.

name: 名词的构成与类别
descs: bark 既是名词狗叫声，也是动词吠
fire engine、police car、racing car 由两个词组成一个名称
plant、water 都可作名词，也可作动词
playground 由 play + ground 组成，写作一个词
racing car driver、zoo keeper 由两个以上名词组成，中心词在后面
racing car 由两个词组成
snowman、ladybug 由两个词合成，写作一个词

name: 副词的用法
descs: Sometimes they dance to the music.
exs: It is always the same shape.
Monday was a hot day, so we went to the beach.
Sometimes the author wants things changed.

name: 其他介词
descs: I can do it all by myself.
a bus with lots of windows
at the park 表示地点
exs: A tiger made that track in the snow.
Bees fly from flower to flower.
I have one head with one neck.
Its head is in its shell.

name: 方位与方向介词
descs: At the beach, I got sand...
Fly bit him on his tail.
exs: I have two eyebrows over my eyes.

name: 特殊疑问句
descs: How do the seeds go away?
What + will + 主语 + 动词原形
exs: How fast can you make a square?
How much sleep do you need?
They go out in the snow when it is cold.
What do fish have on the outside?
When do you use a key?
When the ostriches see a lion, they call out.

name: 动词短语
descs: People get the clay out of the ground.
at 后面接看的人或物
go for a run / have a race / play games
go to the park；但 go home 不加 to
put on / put up / go out
exs: Children have fun when they go for a run.
It makes the birds go away.
They will put on coats and boots.

name: 数量表达
descs: All people need water. Some rain makes puddles.
exs: My eyes have lots of eyelashes.
They have a lot of fur and fat.
a set of big, round shells

name: 否定句
descs: -ing 结尾的词在这里当名词用，表示一种活动
I can't get my hand out!
It can fly. It can't fly.
exs: He didn't see a big net.
Hungry birds can't see them down there.
I can count... / I can't count...

name: 直接引语
descs: said + 人名，常放在引语之后
said 加说话人，放在引语后面
说的话加引号，said 后接说话的对象
说的话放在引号里，said 后面接说话的对象
说的话放在引号里，后面用 said 引出说话的一方

name: 人称代词
descs: I ate it / I ate them
She ran to see… in her dress
They carry heavy things on their backs.
exs: My father likes to play sports.

name: 指示代词 this / that / these
descs: 前者后接名词，后者后接形容词
指代前面提到的单数事物
exs: This door can open and close.

name: 一般过去时
descs: Did + 主语 + 动词原形
It was a red fire engine.
It was delicious. / They were delicious.
The beans are put into a box.

name: 名词所有格
descs: a copy of the book、lots of copies of the book

name: 情态动词 can / could
descs: Can + 主语 + 动词原形
Can you find an old sock?
Could I help you? Could you help me?
You can have half of my pie.
exs: A horse could be a good pet.
People could not wash and dry their clothes in machines.

name: 一般疑问句
descs: Can + 主语 + 动词原形
Can the kangaroo cross over the river? 回答 Yes, I will.
Can you see clouds? 回答 Yes, I can.
Can you whistle? 回答 Yes, I can. / No, I can't.
Could I + 动词原形，客气地请求
exs: A mountain is a big, high place.

name: 感官动词与 like 表比喻
descs: 后面接形容词，不接副词
后面直接接闻到的对象

name: There be 句型
descs: Soon there will be more new butterflies!
There is + 单数，There are + 复数
There is a big light at the top.
exs: There are deserts in very hot places.

name: have / has 表拥有
exs: A whale has a big tail.
I have two hands. / My face has one chin.
Other icebergs have big, long tunnels.
The rainbow has a colour pattern.

name: 物主代词
descs: Its tail is like a big fan.
exs: Its head is under its wing.
it 的形容词性物主代词

name: let / make / help + 动词原形
descs: I showed it to my mother.
So the boy let go of some of the nuts.
We can see it move things.
We put a hat on his head.
exs: She gave a piece of bread to the mouse.
The turtle can give the small fish a ride.
me 是人，the shape 是物

name: 动词不定式 to do
descs: All the children were happy to see Tilly.
It's good to use a crossing.
The fish asked Snake to make him go away.
We have knives to cut our food.
We use paper to make our books.
We wait for cars to stop.
exs: Good drawings help children to read the story.
It is fun to ride on snow.
It needs wind to make it go.
It's time to make the final art.
Joe helped to take the seal back to its home.

name: 一般将来时
descs: The eggs will grow into caterpillars.
You will use glue and scissors.
exs: Lava will run down the mountain.
The storm will have a lot of rain.
We are going to have some hay.
Your muscles will grow bigger and stronger.

name: 比较级与最高级
descs: 两者用比较级，三者及以上用最高级
exs: Some icebergs are as big as tall buildings.
The green car is not the same colour as the others.

name: 时间与条件从句
descs: After 9 weeks, tadpoles grow little front legs.
It helps to keep us dry when it rains.
They sing when the sun shines.
Work with an adult when you cook.
exs: A snake can slide away fast if it sees an enemy.
If it fell off, they had to stop.
If you want to dig, cut, or build, how will you do it?

name: have to / must
exs: All the family had to help.
Beekeepers have to wear special clothes.
People have to wear warm clothes.
We must not put bad things into the oceans.
